title: Release 3.2 dependency register

definitions.meaning: An owner is assigned and work has started; no completion date is implied.

context_note: Updated at biweekly architecture syncs. The sync scheduled for 10 Mar was cancelled.
content:
DEP-07 Billing API v2. API v1 will be retired on 31 March, so release 3.2 must use v2. Status: client implemented against the v2 specification. Sandbox credentials scoped for v2 were requested from customer IT on 18 Feb; status pending as of 24 Feb. Owners: Solution architect (internal), Customer IT (external).

DEP-09 Payment-gateway TLS certificate. Current certificate expires 20 March. Status: in progress – Infrastructure. Note: renewal for customer-owned domains may require action on the customer side.

DEP-11 Single sign-on configuration. Status: done, verified 12 Feb.
